observations: Three black Dell OptiPlex 3000 Thin Client units stacked vertically, held in a hand.
Each unit has the Dell logo and 'OptiPlex 3000 Thin Client' printed on the front.
Top unit has a white sticker: 'USER ID: SC00626'.
Middle unit has a yellow sticky note with red handwriting: 'Loaded 6/16 Office'.

All units appear identical in design and labeling.

risks.proof: Photo of the open unit showing the SSD and RAM modules, or a system information screenshot.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as lower-spec unit (e.g., 64GB/4GB) or as non-functional if specs are not verifiable.

risks.risk: Units may be non-functional or have hardware issues (e.g., dead SSD, faulty ports).
risks.proof: Video showing the unit powering on, booting, and running basic operations.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working until proven functional.

risks.risk: Units may be stolen or have invalid licenses (e.g., 'USER ID: SC00626' may indicate corporate asset).
risks.proof: Photo of the BIOS screen or system information showing license status and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with discount for potential licensing or ownership issues.

Video of the unit powering on and running Windows/Office.

The 'Loaded Office' claim is supported by the sticky note, but internal hardware and working condition require proof. Without proof, pricing is uncertain and risks are high.
